pattern_explanation: Each Polish word looks close to an English word, so learners tend to match by appearance. In this card the look-alike English word has a different meaning, so the correct pair is the English word that carries the same meaning as the Polish word.
false_friend_warning: Polish learners often match the adjective meaning 'current, up to date' with 'actual' because the two look alike, but 'actual' means real or existing, so the correct match is 'current'.
